title: Towards a Computational Theory of Animal Autonomy by Reece Keller
excerpt: This is a ~43 minute talk titled "Towards a computational theory of animal autonomy: modeling task-independent behavior and whole-brain data in zebrafish with intrinsic motivation" by Reece Keller (https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=_2mC_l4AAAAJ&hl=en) given at our Center.
